about_the_game:
“BookShooter"is a roguelike bullet-hell game where a mystical book takes center stage.Harness the power of the enigmatic Book Soul and wield the Laws of a Thousand Pages.Traverse twelve elemental academies and master hundreds of arcane artifacts.Face ancient deities single-handedly amid collapsing storm domes and world-consuming flames.Every battle is an epic saga, and every page turn shakes the very laws of life and death.This is the power of the Tome Apostle—a mortal’s symphony of god-slaying fury!

Game Features

  • Hold your ground and crush enemies from all directions—experience intense combat with just one hand! (What?! No movement controls?!)

  • A dynamic weather system buffs your spells, but watch out—you might get struck by lightning!

  • Customize your playstyle with hundreds of spells across different categories: attack, defense, passives, summons, and ultimate skills.

  • Choose from dozens of unique characters, each with their own spellbook effects. (What?! You just beat the Undying Phoenix using Postpartum Care for Sows?!)

  • Face off against powerful bosses and quirky mobs—trust me, they’re really fun to fight!

  • Unlock elemental academies and master advanced spellcasting techniques to dominate the battlefield!
